readme: researched muscle shares for every database exercise the hand-tuned file does not cover, plus machines the database lacks - read by buildAppData.py
made in the 2026-10-10 data research round from exercise-science sources (listed in data/sources.md); same scale as curatedExercises.json, which always wins over this file
confidence: high / medium = checked against sources or a close well-studied lift; low = anatomy-based estimate (the app still shows 'rough data' on those)
aliases: extra words search should match (gym names the database spells differently)

3_4_Sit-Up.note: partial sit-up, a crunch with a bit more hip flexor pull

Ab_Crunch_Machine.note: machine crunch, same pattern as floor crunch, load on upper rectus first

Advanced_Kettlebell_Windmill.note: windmill: obliques lead, hinge muscles and overhead shoulder stabilisers support

Air_Bike.note: bicycle crunch, obliques plus both rectus parts and hip flexors

Alternate_Hammer_Curl.note: neutral grip, brachioradialis and brachialis work hard

Alternate_Heel_Touchers.note: small lateral crunch side to side

Alternate_Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.note: incline curl, biceps stretched, less brachioradialis

Alternate_Leg_Diagonal_Bound.note: bounding drill: quads and glutes drive each stride, calves spring off

Alternating_Cable_Shoulder_Press.note: overhead press, cable keeps tension, same split as a db press

Alternating_Deltoid_Raise.note: alternates a front raise and a side raise so both delt heads share prime duty

Alternating_Floor_Press.note: floor press stops at the elbow so triceps carries more; alternating arms add some trunk work

Alternating_Hang_Clean.note: kettlebell hip-snap clean: glutes and hamstrings drive it, back and traps finish, light quad bend

Alternating_Kettlebell_Press.note: one-arm-at-a-time overhead press, db press split

Alternating_Kettlebell_Row.note: alternating one-arm kettlebell row, same as one-arm dumbbell row

Alternating_Renegade_Row.note: row from a plank, so lats plus a lot of anti-rotation core and arm support work

Anti-Gravity_Press.note: prone on an incline bench, reverse curl then press the bar forward: rear delt and upper back work to hold the arms up, triceps extend

Around_The_Worlds.note: straight-arm DB arc from thighs to overhead: fly then pullover pattern

Atlas_Stone_Trainer.note: stone lifting trainer, same pattern as Atlas_Stones, unclear equipment

Atlas_Stones.note: hug a stone and lift it to a platform, hip and back drive with a lot of biceps/lat hugging

Axle_Deadlift.note: thick bar deadlift, same muscles with more grip

Back_Flyes_-_With_Bands.note: band reverse fly, rear delt first with upper back and cuff help

Backward_Drag.note: walking backwards against a heavy drag: knee extension each step, glutes and calves assist

Backward_Medicine_Ball_Throw.note: squat down then explosive hip extension and overhead throw behind you: hip and back power with a light shoulder swing

Balance_Board.note: ankle balance work, low load: calves and shin muscles working to stay level

Ball_Leg_Curl.note: heels on ball bridge-curl: hamstrings curl, glutes hold the hips up

Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.note: assisted pull-up, same pattern with a little less grip load

Band_Good_Morning.note: hip hinge with a band: hamstrings stretch, back and glutes hold and drive

Band_Good_Morning_Pull_Through.note: band hip hinge pulling through the legs: glute-led hinge with hamstring stretch

Band_Hip_Adductions.note: squeezing the leg inward against a band: adductors only

Band_Pull_Apart.note: horizontal abduction against a band, rear delt and scapular retractors

Band_Skull_Crusher.note: elbow extension against a band, triceps only

Barbell_Ab_Rollout.note: standing rollout with a barbell, longer lever than wheel from knees

Barbell_Ab_Rollout_-_On_Knees.note: rollout from knees, matches the curated ab roller

Barbell_Curls_Lying_Against_An_Incline.note: chest-down barbell curl, spider-style biceps isolation

Barbell_Full_Squat.note: back squat to full depth: quads prime, glutes and adductors strong at depth

Barbell_Guillotine_Bench_Press.note: bar to the neck with flared elbows: more clavicular fibre and stretch, less triceps

Barbell_Hack_Squat.note: bar held behind the legs, upright squat: quad-heavy, back and grip hold the bar

Barbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise.note: straight arms, bar pushed up by protracting the shoulder blades: serratus first, chest and front delt help

Barbell_Rear_Delt_Row.note: wide bent-over row with flared elbows to bias rear delt over lats

Barbell_Rollout_from_Bench.note: kneeling on a bench rolling a barbell, long lever so lats and delts work harder

Barbell_Seated_Calf_Raise.note: knee bent, bar on thighs: soleus-biased calf raise, calves only

Barbell_Shoulder_Press.note: overhead barbell press, front delt prime, side delt and triceps help

Barbell_Shrug_Behind_The_Back.note: shrug with the bar behind the body, same upper trap work

Barbell_Side_Bend.note: loaded lateral flexion, quadratus lumborum helps, grip holds the bar

Barbell_Side_Split_Squat.note: barbell side squat: sink over one angled leg with the other straight, so adductors work hard on top of quads and glutes

Barbell_Squat_To_A_Bench.note: back squat touching a bench: hips travel back so glutes get more, quads a little less

Barbell_Step_Ups.note: step-up with bar on back: quads and glutes of the working leg, medius steadies the pelvis

Barbell_Walking_Lunge.note: walking lunge with bar: quads and glutes, medius and adductors steady each step

Battling_Ropes.note: ACE EMG shows all three delt heads working (front highest) plus grip and trunk for a rope wave

Bear_Crawl_Sled_Drags.note: crawling on hands and feet pulling a sled: legs drive, shoulders and trunk bear the weight

Bench_Dips.note: hands behind on a bench, triceps drive the lockout, front delt and low chest assist

Bench_Jump.note: explosive two-foot jump up onto a bench: quads and glutes extend, calves spring

Bench_Press_-_Powerlifting.note: competition bench: chest prime, triceps and front delt strong helpers

Bench_Press_-_With_Bands.note: flat bench press with band resistance, same muscles as the barbell bench

Bench_Press_with_Chains.note: bench with accommodating resistance, same muscles weighted toward lockout

Bench_Sprint.note: alternating explosive push-offs from a bench, one leg at a time: single-leg quad and glute extension

Bent-Arm_Barbell_Pullover.note: bent-arm pullover over a bench, lats with chest and long triceps head

Bent-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.note: pec led, bent elbows bring in more triceps (long head); lats help but less than the pec

Bent-Knee_Hip_Raise.note: knees-to-chest hip raise, a reverse crunch variant

Bent_Over_Dumbbell_Rear_Delt_Raise_With_.note: bent-over rear delt raise, head supported

Bent_Over_Low-Pulley_Side_Lateral.note: bent over, cable low pulley pulled up and across: rear delt isolation

Bent_Over_One-Arm_Long_Bar_Row.note: one-arm landmine row, same as one-arm dumbbell row with more low-back hold

Bent_Over_Two-Arm_Long_Bar_Row.note: landmine/T-bar style row, same as T-Bar_Row_with_Handle

Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.note: hinged two-dumbbell row, same pattern as the barbell row

Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row_With_Palms_In.note: neutral grip hinged row, a bit less rear delt, more lat and arm

Bent_Press.note: one-arm press while leaning under the bell, shoulder drives it, obliques control the lean

Board_Press.note: partial-range bench off boards, lockout biased so triceps share rises

Body-Up.note: forearm plank pressed up to the hands: a bodyweight triceps extension with a braced trunk

Bodyweight_Flyes.note: push-up position, hands roll two EZ bars apart: a loaded fly with a big plank demand

Bodyweight_Mid_Row.note: bodyweight row from a bar or table, same as Inverted_Row

Bodyweight_Squat.note: unloaded squat: same pattern as the barbell squat at lower demand

Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.note: walking lunge with no load: quads and glutes, medius and adductors steady

Bosu_Ball_Cable_Crunch_With_Side_Bends.note: cable crunch with a side-bend component

Bottoms-Up_Clean_From_The_Hang_Position.note: kettlebell clean held upside down, grip and wrist stability are the challenge

Bottoms_Up.note: lying hip raise off the floor, reverse crunch pattern

Box_Jump_Multiple_Response.note: repeated box jumps: quads and glutes extend explosively, hamstrings and calves help

Box_Skip.note: skipping up onto a box with a knee drive: quads, glutes, hip flexors and calves

Box_Squat.note: wide-stance sit-back squat to a box: glutes and adductors lead, quads close behind

Box_Squat_with_Bands.note: box squat with bands adding load at the top: same muscles as a box squat

Box_Squat_with_Chains.note: box squat with chains adding load at the top: same muscles as a box squat

Bradford_Rocky_Presses.note: seated press that alternates front and back of the head, so a bit more side and rear delt than a front press

Butt-Ups.note: forearm plank with the pelvis curled up toward the ribs

Butt_Lift_Bridge.note: bodyweight glute bridge: glutes with some hamstring help

Cable_Chest_Press.note: flat cable press, free arms let the shoulder blades protract so serratus counts

Cable_Deadlifts.note: deadlift pulled from a low cable between the legs: hinge plus leg drive, lighter than a barbell pull

Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment.note: rope hammer curl on cable, same as dumbbell hammer

Cable_Hip_Adduction.note: cable pulls the leg inward: adductors, not quads as the database says

Cable_Incline_Pushdown.note: straight-arm pushdown on an incline bench, a lat isolation like Straight-Arm_Pulldown

Cable_Incline_Triceps_Extension.note: lying incline cable extension, triceps only

Cable_Internal_Rotation.note: elbow at the side, rotate inward: subscapularis prime with some pec and lat help

Cable_Iron_Cross.note: straight arms from a T pulled down and in from high pulleys: pec plus a lot of lat, more like a straight-arm pulldown

Cable_Judo_Flip.note: low-to-high diagonal pull then crunch down, a rotating cable chop

Cable_Preacher_Curl.note: preacher curl on cable, biceps isolation

Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.note: cable reverse fly, rear delt prime

Cable_Reverse_Crunch.note: reverse crunch with cable resistance on the legs

Cable_Rope_Rear-Delt_Rows.note: rope pulled to the face with flared elbows: rear delt first, upper back second

Cable_Russian_Twists.note: rotation against a cable, like the curated Russian twist

Cable_Seated_Lateral_Raise.note: per the instructions it is seated and bent over pulling crossed low cables out to the side: a rear delt raise despite the name

Cable_Shoulder_Press.note: overhead cable press, db press split

Cable_Wrist_Curl.note: wrist curl on cable, wrist flexors

Calf-Machine_Shoulder_Shrug.note: shrug with the weight on the shoulders in a calf machine, no grip needed

Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.note: calf raise on the leg press sled: calves only

Calf_Raise_On_A_Dumbbell.note: calf raise balanced on a dumbbell: calves with extra ankle balance work

Car_Deadlift.note: strongman lift of a car frame: deadlift pattern with big grip and back demand

Car_Drivers.note: plate held out in front and turned like a steering wheel: front delt holds it up, trunk rotators and grip work

Carioca_Quick_Step.note: fast sideways crossover footwork: hip abductors, adductors and calves, light quad work

Catch_and_Overhead_Throw.note: plyometric med ball catch and throw, mixed upper body

Chain_Handle_Extension.note: lying cable extension with chains, triceps only

Chain_Press.note: chains on cable handles, a flat dumbbell-style press; loading grows toward lockout so triceps a touch higher

Chair_Squat.note: Smith machine squat with the feet set well forward: quad-biased squat

Chest_Push_from_3_point_stance.note: step-and-throw from a three point stance, light leg drive

Chest_Push_with_Run_Release.note: step-and-throw then sprint; only the throw is a chest movement

Circus_Bell.note: strongman clean and press of an awkward oversized db: legs and back lift it, delts and triceps finish

Clean.note: full clean: leg drive and hip extension, shrug, then a front squat catch

Clean_Deadlift.note: deadlift with a clean-style set-up: deadlift muscles, a little more quad

Clean_Pull.note: clean pulled to the shrug without the catch: legs, hips and traps explode

Clean_Shrug.note: shrug with an explosive leg and hip drive, traps lead, legs help

Clean_and_Jerk.note: full Olympic lift: leg and hip drive, traps in the pull, delts and triceps in the jerk

Clean_and_Press.note: clean then a strict press: more shoulder than the jerk, still a leg and back lift on the way up

Clean_from_Blocks.note: full clean from blocks: shorter pull so less back and hamstring than from the floor

Clock_Push-Up.note: push-up with hands moved around a clock face, shifts load side to side

Close-Grip_Dumbbell_Press.note: narrow db press, triceps led with chest helping

Close-Grip_EZ-Bar_Curl_with_Band.note: close grip EZ curl with band tension, same muscles as the plain one

Close-Grip_EZ-Bar_Press.note: close-grip bench on an EZ bar

Close-Grip_EZ_Bar_Curl.note: narrow EZ grip, a touch more biceps long head and brachioradialis, same shares

Close-Grip_Push-Up_off_of_a_Dumbbell.note: narrow push-up (ACE found triangle push-up the top triceps exercise), chest and front delt join

Close-Grip_Standing_Barbell_Curl.note: narrow grip barbell curl, biceps prime, forearms assist

Cocoons.note: reverse crunch and crunch done together

Conans_Wheel.note: Zercher-style hold of a heavy implement while walking in a circle: elbows, grip, trunk and legs carry it

Concentration_Curls.note: elbow braced on thigh, highest biceps isolation in ACE test

Cross-Body_Crunch.note: twisting crunch toward the opposite knee

Cross_Body_Hammer_Curl.note: hammer curl across the body, same shares

Cross_Over_-_With_Bands.note: standing band fly from a T position, arms meet in front

Crucifix.note: static hold of weights with arms straight out to the sides: side delt and supraspinatus under time, grip fatigue

Crunch_-_Hands_Overhead.note: crunch with arms overhead, same muscles as the plain crunch

Crunch_-_Legs_On_Exercise_Ball.note: floor crunch with calves on a ball

Cuban_Press.note: upright row to external rotation to press with light weight: cuff prime, all delt heads help

Dead_Bug.note: anti-extension hold while limbs move, abs brace rather than shorten

Deadlift_with_Bands.note: deadlift with band tension at the top, same muscles as the barbell deadlift

Deadlift_with_Chains.note: deadlift with chains, same muscles as the barbell deadlift

Decline_Close-Grip_Bench_To_Skull_Crushe.note: a close-grip press then a skull crusher on a decline, triceps throughout

Decline_Crunch.note: decline curl-up, a crunch with some hip flexor involvement

Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.note: decline angle favours sternal pec and drops front delt

Decline_Dumbbell_Flyes.note: decline fly: sternal pec, less front delt

Decline_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.note: decline db skull crusher, triceps only

Decline_EZ_Bar_Triceps_Extension.note: decline EZ skull crusher, triceps only

Decline_Push-Up.note: feet on a box, wide hands: loads the shoulders like an incline press

Decline_Reverse_Crunch.note: inclined reverse crunch was among the highest in EMG testing

Decline_Smith_Press.note: decline press on a fixed path, sternal pec prime

Deficit_Deadlift.note: standing on a plate adds range at the bottom, quads work more

Depth_Jump_Leap.note: drop from a box then leap forward: quads, glutes and calves absorb and fire

Dip_Machine.note: seated dip machine, triceps lead like the triceps-style dip with less delt load

Double_Kettlebell_Alternating_Hang_Clean.note: two heavier kettlebells cleaned from the hang: hip drive, back, traps and grip

Double_Kettlebell_Jerk.note: dip and drive with two bells: leg drive helps, delts and triceps lock it out

Double_Kettlebell_Push_Press.note: push press with two bells, legs start it, delts and triceps finish

Double_Kettlebell_Snatch.note: hip-driven pull to overhead, so hips and back lead (the db tags only shoulders)

Double_Kettlebell_Windmill.note: windmill with two bells, same pattern as the single

Double_Leg_Butt_Kick.note: hopping while kicking heels to the glutes: hamstrings and calves, quads absorb landings

Downward_Facing_Balance.note: face-down on a ball, walk hands out and lift the legs: glutes, hamstrings and back hold the body in line

Drag_Curl.note: elbows go back, bar stays on the body, biceps prime with a little upper back help

Drop_Push.note: drop from two low boxes into a push-up between them: eccentric catch then press

Dumbbell_Alternate_Bicep_Curl.note: standard supinated dumbbell curl, same as Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl

Dumbbell_Bench_Press_with_Neutral_Grip.note: palms-in flat DB press, a little less pec stretch and a bit more triceps

Dumbbell_Clean.note: dumbbell clean: hip and leg drive then catch at the shoulders

Dumbbell_Floor_Press.note: bench press with the range cut off by the floor: chest still prime, triceps work harder

Dumbbell_Incline_Row.note: chest-supported incline row, more upper back, no low back

Dumbbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise.note: arms stay straight and the bells rise by protracting the shoulder blades: serratus

Dumbbell_Lying_One-Arm_Rear_Lateral_Rais.note: chest-down rear lateral raise, one arm

Dumbbell_Lying_Rear_Lateral_Raise.note: chest-down rear lateral raise on a slight incline

Dumbbell_Lying_Supination.note: forearm rotation palm up, supinators with a bit of biceps

Dumbbell_One-Arm_Shoulder_Press.note: one-arm db press, db split plus a little trunk anti-lean

Dumbbell_One-Arm_Upright_Row.note: same as the barbell upright row: side delt and traps (ACE: middle delt highest)

Dumbbell_Prone_Incline_Curl.note: chest-down on incline bench curl, biceps isolation

Dumbbell_Raise.note: instructions describe a plain standing side raise

Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.note: step-back lunge with dumbbells: glutes lean in a bit more, quads still lead

Dumbbell_Scaption.note: raise in the scapular plane 30 degrees forward of the side: front and side delt, supraspinatus, scapular upward rotators

Dumbbell_Seated_Box_Jump.note: jump up from a seated start holding dumbbells: quads and glutes explode

Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise.note: one-leg seated calf raise with dumbbell: calves only

Dumbbell_Squat.note: squat with dumbbells at the sides: same as a barbell squat with a grip demand

Dumbbell_Squat_To_A_Bench.note: dumbbell squat touching a bench: hips sit back so glutes get a bit more

EZ-Bar_Curl.note: EZ bar curl, biceps prime with light wrist/forearm help

Elbow_to_Knee.note: lying twisting crunch, elbow to crossed knee

Elevated_Back_Lunge.note: barbell reverse lunge off a raised platform: longer step back so glutes work harder than a normal lunge

Elevated_Cable_Rows.note: cable row with raised pulley, angled upward pull, like the seated cable row

Exercise_Ball_Crunch.note: swiss ball crunch, no clear difference in rectus activity vs floor crunch

Exercise_Ball_Pull-In.note: feet on ball in push-up position, knees drawn in

Extended_Range_One-Arm_Kettlebell_Floor_.note: one-arm KB floor press with the same-side leg crossed over, trunk resists rotation

External_Rotation.note: side-lying db external rotation, infraspinatus and teres minor prime

Fast_Skipping.note: fast skipping drill: hip flexors, calves and light quad and glute work

Finger_Curls.note: bar rolls to the fingertips and curls closed, finger and wrist flexors

Flat_Bench_Cable_Flyes.note: flat fly on cables, same as the curated dumbbell fly

Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.note: lying knee tuck, lower abs lead

Flat_Bench_Lying_Leg_Raise.note: straight-leg raise, big hip flexor share

Floor_Glute-Ham_Raise.note: partner or anchor holds the feet, you curl the body up from kneeling: hamstrings lead, calves and glutes help

Floor_Press.note: barbell press from the floor, chest prime with high triceps share

Floor_Press_with_Chains.note: floor press with chains, same muscles loaded harder at lockout

Flutter_Kicks.note: face-down on a bench, alternate straight-leg raises: glutes and hamstrings with the back holding on

Forward_Drag_with_Press.note: sled drag walked forward with a press at each step; as much legs as chest

Frankenstein_Squat.note: front squat done with arms out as a technique drill: front squat muscles

Freehand_Jump_Squat.note: bodyweight jump squat: squat muscles plus calves for the take-off

Frog_Sit-Ups.note: butterfly-legged sit-up, rectus abdominis with adductors lightly held in position

Front_Barbell_Squat_To_A_Bench.note: front squat touching a bench: quad-led, hips a bit further back than a free front squat

Front_Box_Jump.note: two-foot jump onto a box: quads and glutes extend explosively, calves spring

Front_Cable_Raise.note: front raise on a cable, same as the db front raise

Front_Cone_Hops_or_hurdle_hops.note: quick two-foot hops over cones: short ground contact so calves and quads spring, glutes less

Front_Incline_Dumbbell_Raise.note: seated incline front raise, front delt prime with the upper chest helping on the lift

Front_Raise_And_Pullover.note: lying barbell arc thighs to overhead: a front raise then a pullover in one rep

Front_Squat_Clean_Grip.note: front squat with clean grip: quad-led squat, upright torso

Front_Squats_With_Two_Kettlebells.note: front squat with a kettlebell in each rack position: quad-led, grip holds the bells

Full_Range-Of-Motion_Lat_Pulldown.note: wide pulldown with the longest stretch, same as the wide pulldown

Gironda_Sternum_Chins.note: lean-back chin-up to the sternum, more upper back than a normal chin-up

Glute_Ham_Raise.note: machine glute-ham raise: hamstrings bend the knee and extend the hip, glutes and calves help

Good_Morning_off_Pins.note: good morning starting from pins at the bottom: back and glutes work harder with no stretch bounce

Gorilla_Chin_Crunch.note: chin-up combined with a hanging knee raise, so the pull muscles count too

Hammer_Grip_Incline_DB_Bench_Press.note: incline DB press with neutral grip, slightly more triceps

Handstand_Push-Ups.note: inverted bodyweight overhead press: front delt prime, triceps strong

Hang_Clean.note: clean from the hang, caught in a front squat: hip drive, shrug, quads on the catch

Hang_Clean_-_Below_the_Knees.note: clean from below the knees: longer pull so more hamstrings and back than a high hang

Hang_Snatch.note: snatch from the hang: hip and leg drive then an overhead catch, so shoulders, traps and triceps work too

Hang_Snatch_-_Below_Knees.note: snatch from below the knees: longer pull so more hamstrings and back than a high hang

Hanging_Bar_Good_Morning.note: good morning with the bar hanging from bands or chains: hinge for hamstrings, back and glutes, with a stability demand

Hanging_Pike.note: straight legs lifted to the bar, like a hanging leg raise with more rectus work

Heaving_Snatch_Balance.note: drop under a bar into an overhead squat: quads and glutes catch it, shoulders and triceps lock it out

Heavy_Bag_Thrust.note: one-hand rotational shove into a heavy bag, trunk twist drives it

High_Cable_Curls.note: arms-out double biceps cable curl, biceps isolation

Hip_Extension_with_Bands.note: standing leg kickback against a band: glutes, hamstrings assist

Hip_Flexion_with_Band.note: knee drive against a band: hip flexors lead, rectus femoris helps; not a quad exercise as tagged

Hip_Lift_with_Band.note: banded hip thrust/bridge: glutes lock out the hips against the band

Hurdle_Hops.note: repeated two-foot hops over hurdles: quads and calves spring, glutes and hamstrings help

Hyperextensions_With_No_Hyperextension_B.note: back extension without the bench, same muscles as Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions

Incline_Bench_Pull.note: prone barbell pull with a wide grip to the chest, upper back leads

Incline_Cable_Chest_Press.note: incline cable press, clavicular fibres lead

Incline_Cable_Flye.note: incline fly on cables, clavicular fibres lead

Incline_Dumbbell_Bench_With_Palms_Facing.note: same as the hammer-grip incline DB press (duplicate row)

Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes_-_With_A_Twist.note: incline fly with a palm twist; same muscles as the plain incline fly

Incline_Hammer_Curls.note: hammer curl on incline bench, biceps stretched

Incline_Inner_Biceps_Curl.note: incline curl with wide elbows, biceps prime

Incline_Push-Up.note: hands raised: easier, mostly sternal pec

Incline_Push-Up_Close-Grip.note: hands raised and narrow: easier push-up, triceps led

Incline_Push-Up_Depth_Jump.note: plyo push-up from feet on a box between two steps, hands drop onto the steps and rebound

Incline_Push-Up_Medium.note: hands raised, medium width; same as the plain incline push-up (duplicate row)

Incline_Push-Up_Reverse_Grip.note: palms-up hands on a Smith bar; palm direction nudges toward upper chest, rest as an incline push-up

Incline_Push-Up_Wide.note: hands raised and wide: less triceps, more serratus

Inverted_Row_with_Straps.note: inverted row on straps, same as Inverted_Row

Iron_Cross.note: database has no instructions; the name points to a held lateral arm position with weights, mapped like the crucifix hold

Isometric_Chest_Squeezes.note: pressing the palms together, an isometric pec squeeze

Isometric_Wipers.note: push-up position shifting weight to one side, one-arm bias like an archer push-up

JM_Press.note: half skull crusher, half close-grip press: triceps, with some chest and front delt

Jackknife_Sit-Up.note: v-sit style, arms and legs meet, strong rectus and oblique output

Janda_Sit-Up.note: sit-up while squeezing glutes and hamstrings to switch off the hip flexors

Jefferson_Squats.note: straddle lift with the bar between the legs: a squat and deadlift hybrid with big adductor and grip demand

Jerk_Balance.note: technique drill: dip and drive of a jerk with a light bar, mostly leg drive and a quick lockout

Jerk_Dip_Squat.note: short dip and drive with the bar on the shoulders: quads work, glutes and calves help

Keg_Load.note: load a keg onto a platform, same hip and back drive as stones, a bit more shoulder

Kettlebell_Arnold_Press.note: Arnold press (rotating press) split from the curated Arnold press

Kettlebell_Dead_Clean.note: kettlebell clean from a dead stop on the floor: hip snap, back, traps and grip

Kettlebell_Figure_8.note: bell passed between the legs while hinged, holds the trunk and grips

Kettlebell_Halo.note: bell circled around the head: delts all round and cuff, a shoulder control drill

Kettlebell_Halo_With_Overhead_Extension.note: halo with an overhead extension added, so triceps rise

Kettlebell_Hang_Clean.note: kettlebell clean from the hang: hip snap, back, traps and grip

Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift.note: single-leg Romanian deadlift: hamstrings and glutes hinge, medius holds the pelvis level

Kettlebell_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.note: overhead extension with a bell, triceps only

Kettlebell_Pass_Between_The_Legs.note: same idea as the figure 8, hinge plus trunk stability

Kettlebell_Pirate_Ships.note: swing a bell side to side at head height: front delt and trunk rotation, grip

Kettlebell_Pistol_Squat.note: one-leg squat to the bottom holding a bell for balance: very high quad, glute and medius demand

Kettlebell_Seated_Press.note: seated overhead bell press, db press split

Kettlebell_Seesaw_Press.note: alternating bell presses, db press split

Kettlebell_Sumo_High_Pull.note: sumo hip drive then a high pull to the chin, so glutes and traps/delts both work

Kettlebell_Thruster.note: front squat into overhead press: legs and delts both prime

Straight-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover.note: EMG puts pec above lats and triceps in the pullover; straight arms lean on lats a bit more

Straight_Raises_on_Incline_Bench.note: chest-down on an incline bench, straight arms raised forward in front of the head: front delt and scapular rotators

Stride_Jump_Crossover.note: long sideways bound crossing one leg over: quads and glutes push, medius and adductors control, calves land

Sumo_Deadlift_with_Bands.note: sumo deadlift with bands adding load at the top: same muscles as a sumo deadlift

Sumo_Deadlift_with_Chains.note: sumo deadlift with chains adding load at the top: same muscles as a sumo deadlift

Supine_Chest_Throw.note: lying chest pass of a med ball straight up, bench-press pattern done fast

Supine_One-Arm_Overhead_Throw.note: lying throw from overhead, abs and lats work together

Supine_Two-Arm_Overhead_Throw.note: two-arm version of the lying throw

Suspended_Fallout.note: TRX fallout, like an ab roller

Suspended_Push-Up.note: straps or rings: EMG higher for pec, delt, triceps and core than the floor push-up

Suspended_Reverse_Crunch.note: feet in straps, plank, knees to chest

Suspended_Row.note: suspension trainer row, same as Inverted_Row

Suspended_Split_Squat.note: rear foot in straps (like a Bulgarian split squat): front-leg quads and glutes, extra balance work for medius

Svend_Press.note: squeeze plates between the palms and press out: isometric pec with light forearm and triceps help

Tate_Press.note: lying db elbow-flexion press to the chest with elbows flared, triceps only

Tire_Flip.note: strongman tire flip: deadlift-style leg and hip drive, then chest and shoulders push the tire over

Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.note: kickback, triceps only (ACE: kickback among the highest triceps EMG)

Triceps_Pushdown_-_V-Bar_Attachment.note: pushdown on a v-bar, triceps only

Tuck_Crunch.note: knees tucked while crunching, both rectus parts

Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Clean.note: explosive hip hinge pulling two bells to the shoulders: hips and back first

Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Jerk.note: dip and drive with two bells: front and side delts, triceps, upper traps with leg drive (as in source)

Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Row.note: two kettlebell hinged row, same as two-dumbbell row

Underhand_Cable_Pulldowns.note: underhand pulldown, chin-up pattern, biceps work harder

V-Bar_Pulldown.note: neutral close grip pulldown, same as close-grip pulldown

V-Bar_Pullup.note: neutral close grip pull-up, lats with strong biceps help

Vertical_Swing.note: dumbbell swung from between the legs to overhead with a jump: hip snap, quads, shoulders and grip

Weighted_Ball_Hyperextension.note: back extension over an exercise ball, same muscles as a back extension

Weighted_Jump_Squat.note: squat jump with a bar on the back: squat muscles plus calves for the take-off

Weighted_Pull_Ups.note: weighted pull-up, same muscles as the pull-up

Weighted_Sissy_Squat.note: knees travel far forward with the hips open: heavy quad work, rectus femoris especially

Weighted_Squat.note: belt squat standing on two benches with the weight hanging between the legs: squat muscles without loading the back

Wide-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.note: wide grip trims triceps and front delt share, pec stays the mover

Wide-Grip_Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.note: decline lines up with the sternal fibres; wide grip lowers triceps and front delt

Wide-Grip_Decline_Barbell_Pullover.note: barbell pullover on a decline bench, same muscle pattern as the DB pullover

Wide-Grip_Pulldown_Behind_The_Neck.note: behind the neck shifts load a little to upper back and traps, lats still prime

Wide-Grip_Rear_Pull-Up.note: wide pull-up to the back of the neck, upper back and traps slightly higher

Wide-Grip_Standing_Barbell_Curl.note: wide grip shifts a bit toward the short head, still biceps prime

Wide_Stance_Barbell_Squat.note: wide-stance back squat: adductors and glutes get more, quads still prime

Wide_Stance_Stiff_Legs.note: wide-stance straight-leg deadlift: hamstrings and adductors stretch, glutes and back work

Wind_Sprints.note: actually a hanging alternate knee raise, so same as hanging leg raise

Wrist_Roller.note: wrists roll the rope up while the arms are held out, delts hold

Wrist_Rotations_with_Straight_Bar.note: roll the bar by rotating the forearm, pronators and supinators

Yoke_Walk.note: walk with a heavy yoke on the shoulders: legs, back and trunk all brace under load

Zercher_Squats.note: bar held in the crook of the elbows: squat muscles with extra trunk, back and biceps work

Zottman_Curl.note: curl up supinated and lower pronated, so biceps up and reverse-curl forearm work down

Zottman_Preacher_Curl.note: curl up supinated and lower pronated, so biceps up and reverse-curl forearm work down

Assisted_Dip_Machine.name: Assisted Dip Machine
Assisted_Dip_Machine.note: upright torso counterweighted dip, curated triceps-version dip pattern

Assisted_Pull-Up_Machine.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
Assisted_Pull-Up_Machine.note: counterweighted pull-up, same muscle split as the curated Pullups

Back_Extension_Machine.name: Back Extension Machine
Back_Extension_Machine.note: selectorized lumbar extension, spinal erectors with less hip drive than the 45 degree bench

Banded_Clamshell.name: Banded Clamshell
Banded_Clamshell.note: side-lying hip abduction and external rotation against a band; glute med EMG is high; runner knee-pain preset research

Belt_Squat_Machine.name: Belt Squat Machine
Belt_Squat_Machine.note: weight hangs from a hip belt, squat pattern with no spinal load

Cable_Bayesian_Curl.name: Cable Bayesian Curl
Cable_Bayesian_Curl.note: single-arm curl facing away from the cable, arm behind the body

Cable_Standing_Hip_Abduction.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
Cable_Standing_Hip_Abduction.note: ankle cuff abduction, like the abductor machine

Cable_Triceps_Kickback.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
Cable_Triceps_Kickback.note: bent-over elbow extension on a cable

Chest_Supported_Row_Machine.name: Chest-Supported Row Machine
Chest_Supported_Row_Machine.note: seated row with a chest pad so no lower back or leg drive, otherwise cable row pattern

Copenhagen_Adductor_Plank.name: Copenhagen Adductor Plank
Copenhagen_Adductor_Plank.note: side plank with the top leg on a bench: long-lever adductor work, obliques and the bottom-side glute med hold the plank; the Copenhagen programme of the soccer preset research

Dead_Hang.name: Dead Hang
Dead_Hang.note: hanging from a bar: grip endurance plus passive shoulder decompression; climbing and grappling preset research

Fixed_Pulldown_Machine.name: Fixed Pulldown Machine
Fixed_Pulldown_Machine.note: selectorized or plate-loaded fixed-path pulldown, same pattern as a cable lat pulldown with less grip and stabiliser demand

Glute_Kickback_Machine.name: Glute Kickback Machine
Glute_Kickback_Machine.note: standing hip extension against a pad, like the curated Glute Kickback

Hangboard_Hang.name: Hangboard Hang
Hangboard_Hang.note: fingerboard hangs: finger flexors are the point, shoulders held engaged; the climbing preset research

Hip_Thrust_Machine.name: Hip Thrust Machine
Hip_Thrust_Machine.note: machine version of the barbell hip thrust

Landmine_Press.name: Landmine Press
Landmine_Press.note: angled one-arm press, shoulder with upper chest and serratus

Landmine_Row.name: Landmine Row
Landmine_Row.note: T-bar style row off a landmine

Lateral_Raise_Machine.name: Lateral Raise Machine
Lateral_Raise_Machine.note: arms pushed out sideways against pads, side delt isolation with a smoother curve than dumbbells

Neck_Extension_Machine.name: Neck Extension Machine
Neck_Extension_Machine.note: head pushed back against a pad, neck extensors

Neck_Flexion_Machine.name: Neck Flexion Machine
Neck_Flexion_Machine.note: head pushed forward against a pad, front neck muscles

Nordic_Hamstring_Curl.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
Nordic_Hamstring_Curl.note: kneeling eccentric knee flexion; biceps femoris and semitendinosus do the work (EMG), gastrocnemius assists; the sprint, soccer and basketball preset research names it the main hamstring-injury preventer

Pec_Fly_Machine.name: Pec Fly Machine
Pec_Fly_Machine.note: front side of the dual fly/rear delt machine, same as the curated Butterfly

Pendulum_Squat.name: Pendulum Squat
Pendulum_Squat.note: arcing machine squat, quad dominant with a bit more glute than a hack squat

Prone_YTW_Raise.name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
Prone_YTW_Raise.note: face-down Y, T and W raises with light weights: scapular retractors and depressors with the rotator cuff; swimming and climbing shoulder-health preset research

Pullover_Machine.name: Pullover Machine
Pullover_Machine.note: arms sweep overhead to the hips against a lever, lats lead

Rear_Delt_Fly_Machine.name: Rear Delt Fly Machine (Reverse Fly)
Rear_Delt_Fly_Machine.note: back side of the dual fly/rear delt machine, same as the curated Reverse Machine Flyes

Rotary_Torso_Machine.name: Rotary Torso Machine
Rotary_Torso_Machine.note: seated trunk rotation against a weight stack

Rotational_Medicine_Ball_Throw.name: Rotational Medicine Ball Throw
Rotational_Medicine_Ball_Throw.note: side-on throw into a wall: trunk rotation power driven from the hips; combat-sport preset research on rotational power

Single_Leg_Romanian_Deadlift.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
Single_Leg_Romanian_Deadlift.note: hip hinge on one leg: hamstrings and glutes as in the RDL, glute med for hip stability; running and field-sport preset research

Single_Leg_Standing_Calf_Raise.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise
Single_Leg_Standing_Calf_Raise.note: straight-knee calf raise on one leg (gastrocnemius and soleus); the marathon and sprint preset research names calf capacity first

Smith_Machine_Hip_Thrust.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
Smith_Machine_Hip_Thrust.note: barbell hip thrust on a Smith bar, same shares as the curated hip thrust
